evidence.claim: Flagged txn 3464869 is $599.94 online, amount_z 3.57, 4.52x the 180d mean of $132.61 and above the card's prior maximum of $550.03.
The transaction came from device 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050', absent from the card's history and marked 'New' on the identity record; no proxy recorded.

Billing region 327 has 0 prior transactions on this card (top regions 325/299/330/225/337/387); mitigating context is that the card is already region- and device-diverse (39 distinct devices over 68 txns), which weakens the 'new device' signal on its own.

Two prior confirmed frauds on this same card, CC-3886 ($175.05) and CC-0615 ($174.99), were both card_not_present_new_device — the same shape as this alert; a third same-customer case CC-1313 was cleared as travel.

The rare device profile on the flagged txn has 8 cards all-time but only 1 card in the window, so no shared-origin ring is evidenced; the large confirmed-fraud lists on linked cards (C06224-K2, C11000-K2, C08918-K2) come through 'Windows | Windows 7 | chrome 65.0 | 1280x1024', a common profile (44 cards all-time, 26 in window) that does not appear in this card's history.
Region 327 shows 15 newcomer cards in 7 days, 5 with confirmed fraud history (0.33 vs 0.10 base rate) including C03042-K1 — mildly elevated but historical, not concurrent confirmed fraud.

The three in-person transactions on 2016-11-16 (3462385 $440.96, 3462387 $550.03, 3462404 $550.01) are in home region 299 with no device or region anomaly and are treated as genuine cardholder activity continuing alongside the online compromise.

Semantically similar cleared cases (CC-0489, CC-0969, CC-2037, CC-4197, CC-2956) were all high-score alerts resolved by confirmed travel; that explanation does not transfer here because the flagged item is card-not-present from a new device, not a card-present trip.
Cardholder denies the $599.94 online purchase and the IE/Windows 8.1 device, while confirming the 2016-11-16 in-person purchases.
R2 applies on denial: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; exposure $599.94 is below $1,000 and no concurrent shared-device or other-card fraud link is established, so a regulatory report is not required.

case.summary: Alert on a $599.94 online purchase (txn 3464869) that is 4.5x the card's mean, above its prior maximum, from a device never seen on the account and flagged 'New', in billing region 327 where the card has no history. Home card-present activity continued normally in region 299 the day before, which is consistent with a stolen number rather than a travelling cardholder. The card already has two confirmed card_not_present_new_device frauds (CC-3886, CC-0615), though its 39-device history makes the new-device flag weak in isolation, so I verified before blocking. The cardholder denies the online purchase, taking the assessment to fraud at 0.87. No credible ring link: the flagged device is on one card in the window, and the heavily fraud-laden linked cards connect only through a common browser profile that this card never used.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Cardholder C03042 states they do not recognize the $599.94 online purchase (txn 3464869) of 2016-11-17 and did not use any Internet Explorer / Windows 8.1 desktop; they confirm the three in-person purchases in region 299 on 2016-11-16 were theirs.

initial.reason: §5/§6: p=0.58 is not decisive; verify before any block
§3a: a case is opened whenever evidence is requested
R1: keep the card active but raise monitoring while verification is pending

final.reason: R2: customer denies the transaction; exposure $599.94 <= $2,500 -> L1
R2/§3a: open the fraud case and write it to the graph

next_best_actions.what_changed: Cardholder denial moved the verdict from uncertain (0.58) to fraud (0.87) and the action from VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER to BLOCK_CARD plus CREATE_CASE under R2; no FILE_REPORT since exposure is under $1,000 and no shared-origin link holds.

sar.reason: Case only, no report: fraud with exposure $599.94 <= $1,000, no shared device/region link and a documented pattern, so no §3a condition holds.

stop_reason: Verification settled the question: denial plus amount/device/region anomalies and the card's prior CNP-new-device frauds give >=0.85 on multiple independent signals; further graph steps would not change the decision.
